owner.sectionDescription: This budget belongs to you, not to this project. Every part you own draws from it, in every project you are in - so parts working elsewhere spend the same allowance as the ones here.
owner.wakesZeroHint: Zero is not silence. Each project keeps a small guaranteed share, so some auto-wakes still arrive, and that share is per project - it adds up across the projects you own. Only urgent can be switched off completely.
owner.urgentZeroHint: Nobody can wake you as urgent.
owner.newPartBudgetHint: A new part draws on the same wake budget as the ones you already own, here and in your other projects - it is yours, not this project's. Adding parts does not add allowance.

project.sectionDescription: Hard limit on recipients for a single broadcast.
project.managerOnly: Only project managers can change this.

audit.title: Who consumed my wake budget
audit.subtitle: Wakes charged to your budget in the last {hours}h.
audit.blockedSendsTitle: Sends of yours that were blocked
audit.blockedSendsSubtitle: These never reached a part, so no part went quiet because of them. They are recorded against you as the sender, which is why they are listed apart from the wakes above. Only loop-breaker trips appear here.
audit.empty: No wakes consumed in this window.
audit.suppressionsSubtitle: Parts of yours that were not nudged in the last {hours}h, and why. A part with nothing here was never withheld from.
audit.suppressionsEmpty: No wake was withheld from your parts in this project.
audit.suppressionsScope: Only wakes that were withheld appear here. A wake that was merged into one already pending is not withheld and is not recorded, so this is not a log of every wake decision.
audit.suppressionsBudgetNote: Budget is the one an owner can change - it is yours and shared across every project you are in.
audit.suppressionsLimitedNote: Provider limits are counted only for messages someone sent. A part parked on a limit is re-checked every 30 seconds and those checks are deliberately not recorded, so the real time spent parked is longer than this count suggests.
audit.suppressionsCooldownNote: A cooldown withholds the nudge only - the message was still delivered, and the part sees it on its next turn.
